purpose: Exercise the authenticated OE-Data code verifier from a small Dolci MILES training run. This is integration validation, not a learning benchmark.
preparation_result: 32 train and 8 eval prompts, full test suites; all 8 negative controls scored zero; 7 of 8 reference controls fully passed.

reuse: Use a new output root for a new run. Launch with MILES_EXISTING_IMAGE set to the recorded image. Beaker resolves the secret name in run.toml; token values are never stored here.
